state_summary: Seed 6101, free_llm32_dual_expert_v1, round 1: 365 observed records, including 32 newly acquired measurements; reported legal pool 2965; no pending records. The supplied catalog supports both targeted condition contrasts and broader graph coverage. Feedback strengthens evidence for scaffold-specific transfer errors and conditional endpoint responses. It weakens a general loading-induced widening rule and supports loading-solvent identity more strongly than plug volume. Current predictions have adapted around several newly measured graphs, while dose sensitivity remains nearly absent. No overall Row accuracy gain is established.
important_observations:
MEASURED FEEDBACK AND HYPOTHESIS REVISIONS:
H_load remains supported only as a conditional response hypothesis. For m8 at 1/1, low/middle/high loading gives V1/V2 approximately 5.32/9.45, 4.23/11.45 and 4.22/13.04 mL (fd0fd67502640304b8fb; a98f3e4664fd05c0f82c; 6c4ddf5ad1cf067b81ee). At 5/1, low versus middle loading gives 5.74/11.29 versus 4.72/14.07 (c8176b3eea7a5d8802dc; 898bde0c214429571108). The m44 high-load repeat 61d5633c7221b3040a5f gives 7.76/20.25 versus the earlier 9.85/20.92, retaining earlier onset and later completion relative to low-load 11.88/17.52. Its onset differs between repeats by 2.09 mL.
A universal positive completion slope is contradicted by m92: at 1/1 with EA loading, increasing mass from 57.75 to 173.25 mg changes 5.18/12.01 to 6.29/9.73 (00a89de0e6cc7377a84b; 4451265787d29526a93a). At 50/1, the same mass increase changes 22.57/52.44 to 20.51/62.21 (1844eab177de5d01fab6; 9bbd36c8b484b5609808). At 10/1, middle-load completion 28.15 exceeds both low-load 21.03 and high-load 24.51. m101's measured completion increase is 0.73 mL at 2/1, versus 2.88 at 1/1. Smooth monotone loading curves and saturation mechanisms remain unestablished.
H_ratio splits into local questions. m173 completion is 108.89, 45.06 and 60.92 mL at 1/1, 2/1 and 5/1 with the same 2000 uL DCM setup (f90a5a5a54509c085ebd; 0b247863fd6e8aaf44d8; 1e775e7d8dcbf48fd6f8), indicating a recorded local trough. m73 intermediate onsets are 5.26 and 5.63 at 2/1 and 5/1, compared with 18.60 at 1/1; the late, narrow 1/1 interval is localized. m80's unusual completion response survives matching loading: 15.66 at 1/1 versus 8.27 at 50/1 at 105.5 mg (55dfd30fde788076a355; 08155ffdcb0d27576050). Its new premeasurement errors were below 0.07 mL for both endpoints.
H_onset is resolved at the tested condition: ce14dd2481560a984aea measured m177 at 10/1 and 140.6 mg as 5.20/20.70, versus the old prediction 0.00/31.74. The onset collapse was a prediction defect there.
H_nitrogen is supported for quinoline transfer, without supporting a generic nitrogen correction. At 5/1, m146 measured 37.67/59.83 and m216 31.43/56.33 (04a2e8ad27ca641a3a12; 1ae3618ec277b0463686), with premeasurement errors -27.84/-32.47 and -20.35/-28.90. In contrast, m160 at 2/1 measured 11.90/33.83 with errors +0.77/+0.56; its difference from the matched meta isomer is only +0.29/+2.26. Nitrogen accessibility as a causal explanation remains untested.
H_injection gains stronger support for solvent identity than plug volume. At fixed m92 mass, mobile phase and 200 uL plug, PE versus EA loading changes V1/V2 by +2.84/+8.56 (e626b5b8083ea1fd02f2; 00a89de0e6cc7377a84b). Reducing m173's DCM plug from 2000 to 1500 uL changes onset by -0.025 and completion by +1.16, with a 0.05 mg mass difference (0b247863fd6e8aaf44d8; 9a32b65bc21fdc5f7286). A general plug-volume effect remains weakly supported.
important_model_behaviors:
CURRENT MODEL DIAGNOSTICS: Loading insensitivity persists after the connected loading program. At measured m92 10/1 inputs, candidates 0389a6366b3a51fad8b5 and ad0ace61c29817c678c2 predict completion 23.806 and 23.814 across a threefold mass increase, versus measured 21.033 and 24.513. At m101 1/1, db7eff29fb2c3ba5bcd3 and a37e31ac2c128f596cf6 predict a completion difference of about 0.010 versus measured 2.875. These comparisons diagnose training-input fit.
TRAJECTORY-LOCAL MODEL CHANGE: Still-eligible m216 candidate 33ffc69a253a89f15995 changed from approximately 11.08/27.42 to 30.30/50.71. m146 candidate 9e3ce3497298084abd83 changed from approximately 9.66/26.44 to 27.01/42.75. These substantial changes show adaptation around newly measured graphs; their unmeasured outcomes remain unknown.
MEASURED PREMEASUREMENT ERROR STRUCTURE: Errors are not a common endpoint offset. For m91 at 2/1, the old predicted band center was 6.95 versus measured 6.80, while predicted elution interval was 11.47 versus measured 2.36. m29 at 50/1 also combined too-early onset with too-late completion. Quinolines, m60 and m199 instead showed underprediction of both endpoints. Center and interval residuals distinguish these problems.
CURRENT QUANTILE DIAGNOSTICS: Crossings persist, although individual old defects changed. d997636736faa38ac83a has V1 q90=3.405 below q50=5.958 despite positive reported width 0.013. adbaa4b00d492d64eed5 has negative V1 width. ce39d1762993bbbafaca has V2 q10 above q50. Numerical width is not calibrated epistemic uncertainty, and point prediction and q50 provide redundant information.
candidate_scientific_questions: Do quinoline responses change sharply between measured ratios, and do current weak-eluent declines persist? Does m91's corrected local response transfer beyond 5/1? Is m73's anomalous 1/1 interval reproducible? Does the measured loading-solvent contrast transfer to another familiar molecule? Can newly learned alcohol and beta-ketoester behavior transfer to related unseen graphs? These questions describe information value without defining a batch.
possible_model_blind_spots: INFERENCES: Persistent flat dose predictions suggest weak condition-feature use or missing molecule-by-condition interactions. Strong graph-specific corrections alongside different endpoint-error signs argue against one global bias adjustment. A graph with similarity 1 can still have only one measured ratio. CHEMICAL/ML PRIORS: Adsorption accessibility, dissolution and injection conditions may explain some responses, but these mechanisms were not measured. Unusual recorded solvent curves prevent treating chemical monotonicity as truth.
possible_learning_bottlenecks: Check numeric scaling, condition encoding, feature routing and output transformations using only the observed trajectory. More loading triplets may have low marginal value until the predictor can use their differences. ML prior: separate modeling or diagnostics of band center and elution interval, with molecule-by-condition interactions, could help capture opposing endpoint movements; improvement is unproven. Use grouped out-of-fold residual checks restricted to the 365 observed records, keeping exact-input replicates together. Separate graph transfer, ratio response, loading response and injection contrasts. Quantile-order repair alone would not establish calibration.
coverage_or_redundancy_concerns:
Across the supplied pool, familiar aromatic compounds and repeated loading grids coexist with unseen pyridyl ketones, amino carbonyls, hydroxy esters, cyclic carbonyls and substituted aromatic families. The previous batch already supplied multiple labels for several difficult graphs; broader transferable support now complements unresolved local contrasts. Ordinary short and moderate retention examples remain relevant to the Row objective.
Group informational redundancy by molecule and all five condition fields. Many eligible IDs encode identical inputs or repeat observed inputs. Preserve catalog multiplicity when assessing Row representativeness, while discounting duplicate information. Different loads remain distinct experiments even when predictions coincide. m60, m181 and m199 now have molecule_novelty=0 and similarity 1 despite only one measured condition each. Binary condition novelty also poorly distinguishes interpolation from remote extrapolation. Further repeats need a specific ambiguity they could resolve.

warnings: The 32 premeasurement residuals are prospective measured feedback for this acquisition, but the adaptively chosen batch is not an unbiased estimate of overall Row error. Repeated memory summaries are not additional measurements. historical_abs_error_ml equals the maximum absolute endpoint error in the supplied acquired examples; initial null errors are unavailable, not zero. Signed errors are prediction minus measurement. Elution interval V2 minus V1 is distinct from predictive quantile width. Only observed-table IDs supply measured outcomes; eligible duplicate inputs remain prediction-only records. Current fit to acquired labels does not establish retraining benefit. m195 observed a917c928912c74862968 has a slightly reversed interval, requiring endpoint-definition awareness. m202's positively charged phosphorus representation should be reconciled with intended experimental identity before interpreting a discrepancy through neutral-compound priors. No validation/test truth, future labels, other seeds or other methods were used.
